_sources: cards.maxStack / age: core/upgrade/UpgradeKind.java (enum constructor args). Speed steps: Upgrades.speedMultiplier. Efficiency: Upgrades.energyMultiplier (-15% per card, floor 40%).

Grinder / Electric Furnace: processing/block/GrinderBlockEntity.KINDS, ElectricFurnaceBlockEntity.KINDS; caps ProcessingMachineBlockEntity.cap -> ProcessingConfig defaults upgradeSlotsMk 2/3/4/5, speedCapMk 2/4/6/8, efficiencyCapMk 2/3/4/4, fortuneCapMk 0/1/2/3, rangeCapMk 0/1/2/3; void 1; fortuneBonus 0.10, xpPerFortune 0.5.

Alloy Smelter / Centrifuge / Assembler: industry/block/ProcessingBlockEntity.acceptedKinds + cardCap (slots tier+1, speed 2*tier, efficiency min(4,tier), fortune tier-1, void 1 Centrifuge only); fortune only on recipes with fortune (alloying by default).

Metal Press: power/block/MetalPressBlockEntity (2 slots, speed 4, efficiency 4). Combustion Generator: CombustionGeneratorBlockEntity (2 slots, speed 3, efficiency 4). Solar Panels: SolarPanelBlockEntity / SolarPanelMenu (2 slots, speed 4, efficiency 4, solarSpeedBonus, solarNightPerCard).

Stumpy / Sprout: automation/entity/FarmBotBlockEntity (4 slots; speed, range, growth capped at the Mk tier; efficiency 4). Excavator Mk1-4: ExcavatorBlockEntity.upgradeCap -> AutomationConfig excavatorSlotsMk 2/3/4/5, excavatorSpeedCapMk 2/4/6/8, excavatorRangeCapMk 1/2/3/4, excavatorEfficiencyCapMk 1/2/3/4, excavatorFortuneCapMk 1/2/3/3, excavatorRangeStep 10. Survey Rig Mk1-4: SurveyRigBlockEntity.upgradeCap -> surveyRigSlotsMk 1/2/3/4, surveyRigSpeedCapMk 2/4/6/8, surveyRigEfficiencyCapMk 1/2/3/4, surveyRigFortuneCapMk 1/2/3/3. Wireless Charger: power/block/WirelessChargerBlockEntity (2 slots, wirelessSpeedCap 4, wirelessRangeCap 4).
Architect Table: architect/block/ArchitectTableBlockEntity (2 slots; speed, efficiency, height at kind maxStack).

Sentry / Courier Drone: drones/entity/SentryDrone, CourierDrone (2 slots; speed, range, efficiency at kind maxStack). Sentry: range +4 blocks per card, attack interval / (1 + 0.4 per speed card). Courier: route +32 blocks per range card, flight speed +50% per speed card (max 3 blocks/tick).
Power tools: gear/GearItems toggles + gear/tool/ToggleKind (AUTO_PICKUP needs PICKUP, VOID_FILTER needs VOID), installed at gear/bench/TinkersBenchMenu.
Storage Terminal: storage/block/StorageTerminalBlock (Carry card by right-click).
Survey Rig rework (edf9936): 1 ore / 400 ticks at 200 FE/t, steep speed factor; DESIGN.md 'Survey Rig'.
_notes: The Mining Drone takes no cards (no Upgrades object in drones/entity/MiningDrone).
The Mining Drone (Mk1-Mk3) takes no cards.

speed.name: Speed Upgrade
speed.summary: Work faster; costs more FE per action.
speed.rules: Each card is one step: x2, x3, x4, x6, x8, x11, x15, x20.

efficiency.name: Efficiency Upgrade
efficiency.rules: Never below 40% of the base cost.

range.name: Range Upgrade
range.rules: What a step means depends on the machine.

fortune.name: Fortune Upgrade
fortune.summary: Fortune I-III; Looting in the Replicator.
fortune.rules: Not together with a Silk Touch card.

silk.name: Silk Touch Upgrade
silk.rules: Single card. Not together with Fortune.

growth.name: Growth Upgrade
growth.summary: +50% crop and sapling growth per card.

void.name: Void Upgrade
void.summary: Deletes junk or outputs that don't fit.
void.rules: Single card. Also the void filter of power tools (Tinker's Bench card slot, no module slot used).

pickup.name: Auto-Pickup Upgrade
pickup.summary: Power tool module: drops go to your inventory.
pickup.rules: Tinker's Bench card slot (uses no module slot). No machine takes it.

height.name: Height Upgrade
height.summary: Architect Table: buildings one block taller per card.

carry.name: Carry Upgrade
carry.summary: Storage Terminal keeps its items when picked up.
carry.rules: Right-click the terminal with it. It stays in for good.

effects.void: Extra outputs that don't fit are deleted instead of stalling.

effects.range: +1 item per lane and cycle per card.
